content.text: Very high-risk ASCVD on max tolerated statin: add ezetimibe and/or a PCSK9 mAb to reach LDL-C <55 mg/dL.
Statin-intolerant: ezetimibe and/or bempedoic acid or a PCSK9 mAb are options.
Inclisiran = reasonable if unable to tolerate or obtain evolocumab or alirocumab, or w a strong preference for less freq dosing.
Lerodalcibep (Lerochol): FDA-labeled adjunct to diet and exercise to ↓LDL-C in adults w hypercholest, incl HeFH.
